summary: STORGATA 17 EIENDOM AS (org. no. 990 678 529) is a private limited company (AS) based in Kristiansund, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2006-12-23. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.200 (Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 4.3 m and net income was NOK 817 248. Board chair: Øivind Hoem; auditor: BDO AS.
